build_MiniRTSNet: build a MiniRTSNet convolutional neural network model with configurable batch normalization and activation functions
build_Model_ActorCritic: build a Model_ActorCritic reinforcement learning model with policy and value heads for action selection
test_Model_ActorCritic: test the Model_ActorCritic model by running a forward pass on an identity matrix input
review_MiniRTSNet_forward: review the MiniRTSNet forward pass that applies four convolutional layers with optional batch normalization
refactor_Models_registry: refactor the Models dictionary registry to map actor_critic key to Model_ActorCritic and ActorCritic classes
